answer: Attention custody windows make each identity answer random signed probes within 90 seconds at four unscheduled intervals; missing two closes its vault for that epoch. Completed windows mint a small ember locked 30 days, so idle sybils gain no transferable value. A sable flag clusters shared timing fingerprints and forces re-verification; each identity costs a persistent low-latency responder for 18 unpredictable hours, or 180,000 attention-hours for 10,000 sybils.
